package teacherdialog_test

import (
	"context"
	"strings"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/studentcontext"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/teacherdialog"
)

type workerJobs struct {
	job              domain.TeacherDialogJob
	hasJob           bool
	claim            repository.TeacherDialogClaim
	savedDecision    domain.TeacherDecision
	savedEvent       domain.IntegrationEvent
	savedBody        string
	completedMessage string
	retriedCode      string
	blockedCode      string
	renewed          int
	reconcileState   domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState
}

type workerUnifiedCoordinator struct {
	processCalls  int
	deliveryCalls int
	processErr    error
	needsDelivery bool
}

func (coordinator *workerUnifiedCoordinator) Process(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	coordinator.processCalls++
	return true, coordinator.processErr
}
func (coordinator *workerUnifiedCoordinator) NeedsDelivery(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	return coordinator.needsDelivery, nil
}
func (coordinator *workerUnifiedCoordinator) Deliver(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) error {
	coordinator.deliveryCalls++
	return nil
}

func (jobs *workerJobs) Accept(context.Context, domain.TeacherDialogJob) (bool, error) {
	return false, nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) Claim(_ context.Context, claim repository.TeacherDialogClaim) (domain.TeacherDialogJob, bool, error) {
	jobs.claim = claim
	if !jobs.hasJob {
		return domain.TeacherDialogJob{}, false, nil
	}
	jobs.job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobProcessing
	jobs.job.ClaimToken = claim.ClaimToken
	jobs.job.WorkerID = claim.WorkerID
	jobs.job.LockedUntil = claim.LockedUntil
	jobs.job.Attempts++
	return jobs.job, true, nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) SaveGenerated(
	_ context.Context, _, _ string, decision domain.TeacherDecision, event domain.IntegrationEvent,
	body, _ string, _ time.Time,
) error {
	jobs.savedDecision = decision
	jobs.savedEvent = event
	jobs.savedBody = body
	jobs.job.DecisionID = decision.ID
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = body
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) SaveCoordinatedResponse(_ context.Context, _, _ string, response domain.TeacherCoordinatedDialogResponse, _ time.Time) error {
	jobs.savedBody = response.Body
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) RenewLease(context.Context, string, string, time.Time, time.Time) error {
	jobs.renewed++
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) RecordFailedNoEffect(context.Context, string, string, domain.TeacherDialogNoEffectProof, domain.TeacherDialogRecoverableOutcome, string, time.Time) error {
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) MarkReconciliation(_ context.Context, _, _ string, state domain.TeacherTurnReconciliationState, _ string, _ time.Time) error {
	jobs.reconcileState = state
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) GetCursor(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherDialogTurnCursor, error) {
	return domain.TeacherDialogTurnCursor{}, nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) CompleteDelivery(_ context.Context, _, _, messageID string, _ time.Time) error {
	jobs.completedMessage = messageID
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = ""
	jobs.hasJob = false
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) Retry(_ context.Context, _, _, code string, _, _ time.Time) error {
	jobs.retriedCode = code
	return nil
}
func (jobs *workerJobs) Block(_ context.Context, _, _, code string, _ time.Time) error {
	jobs.blockedCode = code
	return nil
}

type teacherReader struct {
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher
	err     error
}

func (reader teacherReader) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	return reader.teacher, reader.err
}

type soulReader struct {
	soul  domain.TeacherSoul
	err   error
	calls int
}

func (reader *soulReader) Execute(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	reader.calls++
	return reader.soul, reader.err
}

type studentBuilder struct {
	value domain.StudentContext
	err   error
	calls int
}

func (builder *studentBuilder) Execute(_ context.Context, input studentcontext.BuildInput) (domain.StudentContext, error) {
	builder.calls++
	value := builder.value
	value.StudentID = input.StudentID
	value.LearningActionID = input.LearningActionID
	value.ContextType = input.ContextType
	value.ContextID = input.ContextID
	if input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextPracticeTask || input.ContextType == domain.LearningContextProject {
		practice := domain.PracticeTaskContext{
			Schema: domain.PracticeTaskContextSchemaV1, TaskInstanceID: input.ContextID,
			StudentID: input.StudentID, TaskRevisionID: "88888888-8888-4888-8888-888888888888",
			LearningActionID: input.LearningActionID, Surface: "practice", Locale: "ru", Status: "ACTIVE",
			Step:             domain.PracticeTaskStepContext{ID: "implement", Title: "Implement", Objective: "Build", Status: "AVAILABLE"},
			AssistancePolicy: domain.PracticeTaskAssistancePolicy{Version: 1, MaxHintLevel: 2, Teacher: domain.PracticeTeacherPolicy{MayExplain: true}},
		}
		value.TaskID = practice.TaskRevisionID
		value.PracticeTask = &practice
	} else {
		value.PracticeTask = nil
	}
	return value, builder.err
}

type dialogBoundary struct {
	context     domain.DialogRequestContext
	contextErr  error
	appendErr   error
	readCalls   int
	appendCalls int
	appendKey   string
	appendBody  string
}

func (boundary *dialogBoundary) GetTeacherRequestContext(context.Context, domain.DialogTeacherRequest, int) (domain.DialogRequestContext, error) {
	boundary.readCalls++
	return boundary.context, boundary.contextErr
}
func (boundary *dialogBoundary) AppendTeacherResponse(
	_ context.Context, request domain.DialogTeacherRequest, key, body string,
) (domain.DialogMessage, error) {
	boundary.appendCalls++
	boundary.appendKey = key
	boundary.appendBody = body
	if boundary.appendErr != nil {
		return domain.DialogMessage{}, boundary.appendErr
	}
	return domain.DialogMessage{
		ID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", DialogID: request.DialogID,
		AuthorType: domain.DialogMessageAuthorPersonalTeacher, Channel: request.SourceChannel, PersonalTeacherID: request.PersonalTeacherID,
		LearningActionID: request.LearningActionID, ReplyToMessageID: request.SourceMessageID,
		Body: body, Status: 1, MessageSequence: request.SourceSequence + 1,
		LastEventSequence: request.EventSequence + 1, CreatedAt: time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC),
	}, nil
}

type decisionHistory struct {
	values []domain.TeacherDecision
	jobs   *workerJobs
}

func (history decisionHistory) ListByLearningAction(context.Context, string, string) ([]domain.TeacherDecision, error) {
	if history.jobs != nil && history.jobs.savedDecision.ID != "" {
		return []domain.TeacherDecision{history.jobs.savedDecision}, nil
	}
	return history.values, nil
}

type practiceAssistanceRecorder struct {
	calls      int
	instanceID string
	studentID  string
	action     domain.TeacherAction
	hintLevel  *int
	stepID     string
	usageID    string
	err        error
}

func (recorder *practiceAssistanceRecorder) RecordPracticeTaskAssistance(
	_ context.Context, instanceID, studentID, stepID, usageID string, action domain.TeacherAction, hintLevel *int,
) error {
	recorder.calls++
	recorder.instanceID, recorder.studentID, recorder.action, recorder.hintLevel = instanceID, studentID, action, hintLevel
	recorder.stepID = stepID
	recorder.usageID = usageID
	return recorder.err
}

type responseGenerator struct {
	response    domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse
	generateErr error
	replayErr   error
	generated   int
	replayed    int
	request     domain.TeacherGenerationRequest
}

func (generator *responseGenerator) Generate(_ context.Context, request domain.TeacherGenerationRequest) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	generator.generated++
	generator.request = request
	return generator.response, generator.generateErr
}

type courseLessonReader struct {
	content  domain.CourseLessonContent
	err      error
	calls    int
	lessonID string
	language string
}

type channelDeliveryStub struct {
	sourceMessageID string
	studentID       string
	body            string
}

func (stub *channelDeliveryStub) EnqueueDelivery(_ context.Context, sourceMessageID, studentID, body string, _ time.Time) error {
	stub.sourceMessageID, stub.studentID, stub.body = sourceMessageID, studentID, body
	return nil
}

func (reader *courseLessonReader) GetLessonContext(_ context.Context, lessonID, language string) (domain.CourseLessonContent, error) {
	reader.calls++
	reader.lessonID = lessonID
	reader.language = language
	return reader.content, reader.err
}
func (generator *responseGenerator) Replay(context.Context, string) (domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse, error) {
	generator.replayed++
	return generator.response, generator.replayErr
}

type workerIDs struct{ values []string }

func (ids *workerIDs) NewID() string {
	value := ids.values[0]
	ids.values = ids.values[1:]
	return value
}

func TestWorkerAtomicallyStagesDecisionThenDeliversWithSourceEventKey(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionGiveHint, jobs.savedDecision.Action)
	require.Equal(t, 1, *jobs.savedDecision.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, validDialogRequest().EventID, jobs.savedDecision.CausationID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.SubjectTeacherDecisionRecorded, jobs.savedEvent.Subject)
	require.Equal(t, "Проверь границу цикла.", jobs.savedBody)
	require.Equal(t, validDialogRequest().EventID, dialog.appendKey)
	require.Equal(t, "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", jobs.completedMessage)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
}

func TestWorkerProcessesGeneralTeacherRequestFromLearnerOverview(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, _, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	request := jobs.job.Request
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	request.ContextID = ""
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	jobs.job.Request = request
	builder.value = domain.StudentContext{StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextGeneral}
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextGeneral
	dialog.context.ContextID = ""
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionRespond, jobs.savedDecision.Action)
	require.Nil(t, jobs.savedDecision.HintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, request.DialogID, jobs.savedDecision.CorrelationID)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LearningContextGeneral, jobs.savedDecision.ContextType)
}

func TestWorkerProcessesSelectionVerifiedAgainstExactCourseRevision(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	request := jobs.job.Request
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	jobs.job.Request = request
	revision := "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z"
	selectedText := "errors.Is(err, target)"
	builder.value = domain.StudentContext{
		StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: request.ContextID,
	}
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext = &domain.LessonMessageContext{
		Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: domain.LessonMessageModeSelection,
		CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: request.ContextID,
		ContentRevision: revision, SelectedText: selectedText,
	}
	course := &courseLessonReader{content: domain.CourseLessonContent{
		LessonID: request.ContextID, CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SectionID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", Language: "ru", Title: "Ошибки",
		Description: "Проверяйте цепочку через errors.Is(err, target).", ContentRevision: revision,
	}}
	worker.CourseLessons = course

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, course.calls)
	require.Equal(t, request.ContextID, course.lessonID)
	require.Equal(t, "ru", course.language)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionRespond, jobs.savedDecision.Action)
	require.NotNil(t, generator.request.Lesson)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageModeSelection, generator.request.Lesson.Mode)
	require.Equal(t, selectedText, generator.request.Lesson.SelectedText)
	require.Empty(t, generator.request.Lesson.Title)
	require.Empty(t, generator.request.Lesson.Excerpt)
}

func TestWorkerProcessesOverviewWithBoundedCourseProjectionAndExistingStudentContext(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	request := jobs.job.Request
	request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	request.LearningActionID = ""
	jobs.job.Request = request
	revision := "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z"
	builder.value = domain.StudentContext{
		StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: request.ContextID,
	}
	dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
	dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
	dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext = &domain.LessonMessageContext{
		Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: domain.LessonMessageModeOverview,
		CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: request.ContextID,
		ContentRevision: revision,
	}
	course := &courseLessonReader{content: domain.CourseLessonContent{
		LessonID: request.ContextID, CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa",
		SectionID: "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb", Language: "ru", Title: "Ошибки",
		Excerpt: "Краткое публичное введение.", Description: "Полный приватный контент урока.",
		ContentRevision: revision,
	}}
	worker.CourseLessons = course

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, builder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherActionRespond, jobs.savedDecision.Action)
	require.Equal(t, "verified_lesson_overview", jobs.savedDecision.ReasonCode)
	require.NotNil(t, generator.request.Lesson)
	require.Equal(t, domain.LessonMessageModeOverview, generator.request.Lesson.Mode)
	require.Equal(t, course.content.Title, generator.request.Lesson.Title)
	require.Equal(t, course.content.Excerpt, generator.request.Lesson.Excerpt)
	require.Equal(t, course.content.SectionID, generator.request.Lesson.SectionID)
	require.Empty(t, generator.request.Lesson.SelectedText)
	require.NotContains(t, generator.request.Lesson.Excerpt, course.content.Description)
}

func TestWorkerBlocksStaleMismatchedOrOversizedLessonContext(t *testing.T) {
	tests := []struct {
		name   string
		mutate func(*domain.LessonMessageContext, *domain.CourseLessonContent)
	}{
		{
			name: "stale revision",
			mutate: func(_ *domain.LessonMessageContext, content *domain.CourseLessonContent) {
				content.ContentRevision = "2026-08-31T09:01:00Z"
			},
		},
		{
			name: "course mismatch",
			mutate: func(_ *domain.LessonMessageContext, content *domain.CourseLessonContent) {
				content.CourseID = "cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc"
			},
		},
		{
			name: "oversized excerpt",
			mutate: func(_ *domain.LessonMessageContext, content *domain.CourseLessonContent) {
				content.Excerpt = strings.Repeat("я", domain.MaximumLessonOverviewExcerptRunes+1)
			},
		},
	}
	for _, tt := range tests {
		t.Run(tt.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
			request := jobs.job.Request
			request.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
			request.LearningActionID = ""
			jobs.job.Request = request
			builder.value = domain.StudentContext{
				StudentID: request.StudentID, ContextType: domain.LearningContextLesson, ContextID: request.ContextID,
			}
			dialog.context.ContextType = domain.LearningContextLesson
			dialog.context.LearningActionID = ""
			dialog.context.Messages[0].LearningActionID = ""
			source := &domain.LessonMessageContext{
				Schema: domain.LessonMessageContextSchemaVersion, Mode: domain.LessonMessageModeOverview,
				CourseID: "aaaaaaaa-aaaa-4aaa-8aaa-aaaaaaaaaaaa", LessonID: request.ContextID,
				ContentRevision: "2026-08-31T09:00:00Z",
			}
			dialog.context.Messages[0].LessonContext = source
			content := domain.CourseLessonContent{
				LessonID: request.ContextID, CourseID: source.CourseID, Language: "ru", Title: "Ошибки",
				Excerpt: "Краткое введение.", Description: "Полный контент.", ContentRevision: source.ContentRevision,
			}
			tt.mutate(source, &content)
			worker.CourseLessons = &courseLessonReader{content: content}

			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrInvalidLessonContext)
			require.True(t, claimed)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDialogContext, jobs.blockedCode)
			require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
		})
	}
}

func TestWorkerResumesPendingDeliveryWithoutReloadingPrivateContext(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, souls := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Status = domain.TeacherDialogJobDeliveryPending
	jobs.job.DecisionID = "bbbbbbbb-bbbb-4bbb-8bbb-bbbbbbbbbbbb"
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = "Уже сгенерированный ответ."
	jobs.job.Attempts = 1

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Zero(t, souls.calls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Equal(t, "Уже сгенерированный ответ.", dialog.appendBody)
}

func TestWorkerQueuesTelegramDeliveryAfterCanonicalDialogAppend(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, _, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Request.SourceChannel = domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram
	dialog.context.Messages[len(dialog.context.Messages)-1].Channel = domain.DialogMessageChannelTelegram
	delivery := &channelDeliveryStub{}
	worker.ChannelDelivery = delivery

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.SourceMessageID, delivery.sourceMessageID)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.StudentID, delivery.studentID)
	require.Equal(t, "Проверь границу цикла.", delivery.body)
}

func TestWorkerRecoversCommittedGenerationThroughReplayAfterHashConflict(t *testing.T) {
	worker, _, _, generator, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	generator.generateErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.replayed)
}

func TestWorkerRetriesWhenConflictingGenerationHasNoReplayableResult(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, generator, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	generator.generateErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationConflict
	generator.replayErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationNotFound

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationNotFound)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.replayed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, jobs.retriedCode)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.blockedCode)
}

func TestWorkerBlocksPermanentlyClosedStudentContext(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, _, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	builder.err = domain.ErrLearningActionClosed

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrLearningActionClosed)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorStudentContext, jobs.blockedCode)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.retriedCode)
}

func TestWorkerSchedulesBoundedRetryForTransientGenerationFailure(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, generator, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	generator.generateErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorGeneration, jobs.retriedCode)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.blockedCode)
}

func TestWorkerBlocksActionReceiptBeforeAnyLLMOrStudentWork(t *testing.T) {
	for _, coordinatorEnabled := range []bool{false} {
		t.Run(map[bool]string{false: "dark"}[coordinatorEnabled], func(t *testing.T) {
			worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
			jobs.job.Request.ActionReceiptID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
			worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = coordinatorEnabled
			claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
			require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherDialogCanonicalActionBlocked)
			require.True(t, claimed)
			require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
			require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
			require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
			require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorUnsupportedContext, jobs.retriedCode)
		})
	}
}

func TestWorkerRoutesPersistedCanonicalActionByDurableModeWithAdmissionFlagOff(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Request.ActionReceiptID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	jobs.job.CoordinatorMode = string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorAction)
	coordinator := &workerUnifiedCoordinator{}
	worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = false
	worker.OnboardingCoordinator = coordinator

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, coordinator.processCalls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
}

func TestWorkerEnabledCoordinatorFailureFailsClosedBeforeGenericLLM(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Request.ActionReceiptID = "77777777-7777-4777-8777-777777777777"
	coordinator := &workerUnifiedCoordinator{processErr: domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable}
	worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	worker.OnboardingCoordinator = coordinator

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherOnboardingUnavailable)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, coordinator.processCalls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
}

func TestWorkerReclaimsSemanticResponseStagedBeforeStudentAsCoordinatorProcessNotDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	// This is the crash window after S5 atomically stores the validated
	// response body with its ai_staged decision, but before Student Apply.
	// response_body alone must never select Dialog delivery.
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = "validated semantic reply"
	jobs.job.CoordinatorMode = string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText)
	coordinator := &workerUnifiedCoordinator{needsDelivery: false}
	worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	worker.OnboardingCoordinator = coordinator

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 1, coordinator.processCalls)
	require.Zero(t, coordinator.deliveryCalls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Zero(t, dialog.appendCalls)
}

func TestWorkerDeliversOnlyWhenCoordinatorMarksPersistedTurnDeliveryPending(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.ResponseBody = "final staged response"
	jobs.job.CoordinatorMode = string(domain.TeacherOnboardingCoordinatorText)
	coordinator := &workerUnifiedCoordinator{needsDelivery: true}
	worker.UnifiedCoordinatorEnabled = true
	worker.OnboardingCoordinator = coordinator

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Zero(t, coordinator.processCalls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, coordinator.deliveryCalls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
}

func TestWorkerPersistsAndReusesExactPracticeStepForAssistanceDelivery(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, _, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	recorder := &practiceAssistanceRecorder{}
	worker.PracticeAssistance = recorder
	worker.Decisions = decisionHistory{jobs: jobs}

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, "implement", jobs.savedDecision.PracticeStepID)
	require.Equal(t, "implement", recorder.stepID)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.savedDecision.ID, recorder.usageID)
}

func TestWorkerRetryExhaustionBlocksForReconciliationWithoutAdvancing(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, _, generator, _, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	jobs.job.Attempts = worker.MaxAttempts - 1
	generator.generateErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherTurnUnknown, jobs.reconcileState)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.retriedCode)
}

func TestWorkerBlocksOversizedExactSourceWithBoundedContextCode(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, _ := validWorkerFixture(t)
	dialog.context.Messages[len(dialog.context.Messages)-1].Body = strings.Repeat("я", domain.TeacherContextMaximumExcerptRunes+1)

	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrTeacherContextSourceTooLarge)
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorContextBudget, jobs.blockedCode)
	require.Zero(t, builder.calls)
	require.Zero(t, generator.generated)
}

func validWorkerFixture(t *testing.T) (
	teacherdialog.Worker,
	*workerJobs,
	*dialogBoundary,
	*responseGenerator,
	*studentBuilder,
	*soulReader,
) {
	t.Helper()
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 31, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	job, err := domain.NewTeacherDialogJob(validDialogRequest(), now.Add(-time.Minute))
	require.NoError(t, err)
	jobs := &workerJobs{job: job, hasJob: true}
	dialog := &dialogBoundary{context: validDialogContext()}
	builder := &studentBuilder{value: validStudentContext()}
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(
		validDialogRequest().PersonalTeacherID, validDialogRequest().StudentID,
		domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now.Add(-time.Hour),
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	souls := &soulReader{soul: soul}
	generator := &responseGenerator{response: domain.TeacherGeneratedResponse{
		ExecutionID: "99999999-9999-4999-8999-999999999999", IdempotencyKey: validDialogRequest().EventID,
		TemplateCode: domain.TeacherResponseTemplateCode, TemplateVersion: 1,
		ProviderCode: "openai", ProviderModel: "teacher-model", LanguageCode: "ru",
		ResponseSchemaCode: domain.TeacherResponseSchemaCode, Body: "Проверь границу цикла.",
		CreatedAt: now.Add(-time.Second), ExpiresAt: now.Add(time.Hour),
	}}
	return teacherdialog.Worker{
		Jobs: jobs, Teachers: teacherReader{teacher: validTeacher()}, Souls: souls, StudentContext: builder,
		PromptContext: teacherdialog.ContextBuilder{},
		DialogReader:  dialog, DialogAppender: dialog, Decisions: decisionHistory{},
		Pedagogy: pedagogyRegistry(t), Generator: generator,
		IDs: &workerIDs{values: []string{
			"cccccccc-cccc-4ccc-8ccc-cccccccccccc",
			"dddddddd-dddd-4ddd-8ddd-dddddddddddd",
			"eeeeeeee-eeee-4eee-8eee-eeeeeeeeeeee",
		}},
		Clock: dialogClock{value: now}, WorkerID: "teacher-worker-test", LeaseTTL: 2 * time.Minute,
		LeaseRenewInterval: 10 * time.Second, MaxAttempts: 20,
		RetryBaseDelay: time.Second, RetryMaxDelay: 5 * time.Minute,
	}, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, souls
}

func TestT13WorkerRecoversAfterAssistanceThenAppendFaultWithoutRegeneration(t *testing.T) {
	worker, jobs, dialog, generator, builder, souls := validWorkerFixture(t)
	recorder := &practiceAssistanceRecorder{}
	worker.PracticeAssistance = recorder
	worker.Decisions = decisionHistory{jobs: jobs}
	dialog.appendErr = domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable
	claimed, err := worker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.ErrorIs(t, err, domain.ErrStudentStateUnavailable)
	require.Equal(t, 1, recorder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
	require.Equal(t, 1, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.completedMessage)
	require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.job.ResponseBody)
	decision := jobs.savedDecision
	require.Equal(t, decision.ID, recorder.usageID)
	require.Equal(t, decision.PracticeStepID, recorder.stepID)
	require.Equal(t, decision.Action, recorder.action)
	require.Equal(t, decision.HintLevel, recorder.hintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, domain.TeacherDialogErrorDelivery, jobs.retriedCode)
	// Reconstruct the worker with the durable job/decision and an unavailable
	// fresh context. Recovery must deliver the saved body with the same usage.
	reads, builds, soulReads := dialog.readCalls, builder.calls, souls.calls
	builder.err = domain.ErrLearningActionClosed
	generator.generateErr = domain.ErrTeacherGenerationUnavailable
	dialog.appendErr = nil
	recoveredWorker := worker
	recoveredWorker.IDs = &workerIDs{values: []string{"11111111-1111-4111-8111-111111111111", "22222222-2222-4222-8222-222222222222"}}
	claimed, err = recoveredWorker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.True(t, claimed)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, 2, recorder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, decision.ID, recorder.usageID)
	require.Equal(t, decision.PracticeStepID, recorder.stepID)
	require.Equal(t, decision.Action, recorder.action)
	require.Equal(t, decision.HintLevel, recorder.hintLevel)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.ContextID, recorder.instanceID)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.StudentID, recorder.studentID)
	require.Equal(t, 1, generator.generated)
	require.Zero(t, generator.replayed)
	require.Equal(t, reads, dialog.readCalls)
	require.Equal(t, builds, builder.calls)
	require.Equal(t, soulReads, souls.calls)
	require.Equal(t, 2, dialog.appendCalls)
	require.Equal(t, jobs.job.Request.EventID, dialog.appendKey)
	require.NotEmpty(t, jobs.completedMessage)
	require.Empty(t, jobs.job.ResponseBody)
	claimed, err = recoveredWorker.ProcessNext(context.Background())
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.False(t, claimed)
	require.Equal(t, 2, recorder.calls)
}
